scenes.name: Turntablism
scenes.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: El underground revitaliza la figura del DJ, ausente de los vídeos de la MTV: el turntablism trasciende los campeonatos como vía discursiva (Invisibl Skratch Piklz, X-Ecutioners, Beat Junkies).
scenes.family: Hip hop, breaks y ritmo lento

podcast.title: Continuing Turntablism and Scratching
podcast.body: Kid Koala is mentioned as one of the artists who continued to produce material within the turntablism and scratching culture during the mid-1990s, an era that saw a coexistence of old-school and new-school DJing styles. "desde los discos de Kidcuala, Kidverse grías sacando material."

podcast.title: Gorillaz Debut Album Collaboration
podcast.body: Kid Koala, a turntablist, was brought in by Damon Albarn to contribute to the Gorillaz's debut album. "Damon, being responsible for the music, brought in rapper Del the funky homo sapien, turned table as Kid Koala, an American hip-hop producer, Dan the Automator."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Scratching as an Instrument
podcast.body: Kit Koala is noted for converting scratching not merely into a sound effect, but almost into a full-fledged instrument. This experimental approach is particularly evident in tracks like "Drank Trampet." "Kit Koala convierte el scratching no tanto en un sonido sino casi en un instrumento."

xref.title: Gorillaz Debut Album Collaboration
xref.body: Del the Funky Homosapien contributed as a rapper to the Gorillaz's debut album and was featured on the single "Clint Eastwood." In Gorillaz lore, he is identified as "Del the ghost rapper," one of the spirits inhabiting Russell Hobbs, and is visually depicted as a blue phantom in the music video. "Damon, being responsible for the music, brought in rapper Del the funky homo sapien, turned table as Kid Koala, an American hip-hop producer, Dan the Automator."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Gorillaz Debut Album Production
xref.body: Dan the Automator, an American hip-hop producer, was involved in the production of the Gorillaz's debut album. "Damon, being responsible for the music, brought in rapper Del the funky homo sapien, turned table as Kid Koala, an American hip-hop producer, Dan the Automator."
